description: Five-panel TEM composite (three micrographs plus two selected-area diffraction patterns) recording the microstructure of the as-cast 3Cr low-density steel strip. (a) Bright-field (BF) image of γ-austenite, annotated in yellow "γ + κ", with a 500 nm scale bar; the grain shows dark banded contrast, bend contours and dislocation lines. (b) SADP along the [110] zone axis of the γ-austenite, labelled "[110]γ+κ" at lower left, with spots marked 1̄10, 1̄11, 001 and 002; the 001/002 superlattice reflections are visibly weaker than the fundamental spots. (c) BF image of δ-ferrite, annotated in yellow "δ + DO3", 500 nm scale bar, a largely featureless dark matrix with wavy bend contours. (d) Dark-field (DF) image formed with the (002) superlattice reflection, annotated "(002)" top-right and "δ + DO3", 500 nm scale bar, revealing densely distributed bright nano-particles in a dark matrix. (e) SADP along [110]δ+DO3 from the δ-ferrite, labelled 002̄, 002̄, 1̄11 and 1̄10, including weak superlattice spots. Together the panels show the as-cast 3Cr strip consists of γ-austenite carrying a small κ-carbide fraction plus δ-ferrite containing nano-scale DO3 precipitates; all three micrographs carry 500 nm scale bars and no numeric axes are plotted.

subfigures.description: BF TEM micrograph of γ-austenite in the as-cast 3Cr steel strip, annotated in yellow 'γ + κ'; dark banded contrast with bend contours and dislocations; 500 nm scale bar at bottom right.
SADP along the [110] zone axis of γ-austenite, labelled [110]γ+κ at bottom left; individual reflections marked 1̄10, 1̄11, 001 and 002, the 001/002 superlattice spots being the faintest.
BF TEM micrograph of δ-ferrite, annotated in yellow 'δ + DO3'; nearly featureless dark matrix with bend contours; 500 nm scale bar at bottom right.

Dark-field TEM image using the (002) superlattice reflection, annotated '(002)' (top right) and 'δ + DO3' (yellow); dense bright nano-scale particles uniformly distributed in a dark matrix; 500 nm scale bar.
SADP along the [110]δ+DO3 zone axis from δ-ferrite, labelled [110]δ+DO3 at bottom left; reflections marked 002̄, 002̄, 1̄11 and 1̄10 with weak superlattice spots between the strong fundamental spots.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM image of γ-austenite in the as-cast 3Cr steel strip, annotated 'γ + κ' and carrying a 500 nm scale bar.
Panel (b) is an SADP taken along the [110] zone axis from the γ-austenite and is labelled [110]γ+κ; its reflections are indexed 1̄10, 1̄11, 001 and 002.
In panel (b) the 001 and 002 superlattice reflections are markedly fainter than the fundamental reflections, consistent with a low κ-carbide volume fraction.
Panel (c) is a bright-field TEM image of δ-ferrite annotated 'δ + DO3' with a 500 nm scale bar.
Panel (d) is a DF image formed with the (002) superlattice reflection (annotation '(002)' at top right, 'δ + DO3' in yellow) showing densely distributed bright nano-particles in a dark matrix.
Panel (d) is annotated '(002)' while the caption writes '(00̄2)' for the reflection used for the dark-field image — the two notations differ.
Panel (e) is an SADP along the [110]δ+DO3 zone axis from the δ-ferrite, with labelled reflections 002̄, 002̄, 1̄11 and 1̄10, including superlattice spots additional to the fundamental δ reflections.
The caption states that the DF image in (d) using (00̄2) shows DO3 nanoparticles of size 30 ± 3 nm densely distributed in the δ-ferrite.
The caption states that the measured lattice parameter of the κ-carbides and γ-austenite in the as-cast 3Cr steel strip is 0.387 nm and 0.376 nm, respectively.

The citing text states the superlattice reflection intensity is so weak that the precipitation cannot be recognized in the DF image from the (001) superlattice reflection, indicating the κ-carbide volume fraction decreases relative to the Cr-free sample.
The citing text states that a DF image using (00̄2) shows DO3 nanoparticles 30 ± 3 nm in size, consistent with the superlattice reflections in the SADP along [110] in the δ-ferrite.
All three micrographs in the group ((a), (c), (d)) carry a 500 nm scale bar, whereas the two diffraction patterns ((b), (e)) carry no scale bar and no numeric axes.

unreadable_items: panel (b): exact placement of the overbar on individual Miller indices (1̄10, 1̄11) is only partially legible at the supplied resolution
panel (e): the overbar/underscore on the two 002 and on 1̄11/1̄10 labels is partially legible
panels (a), (c), (d): no particle-size measurement is printed on the images themselves; the 30 ± 3 nm value comes only from the caption/citation
